headline: Reps finding: evidence comes from setup-DAYS, not trades - a session is worth ~5 independent trades however many it holds, so the fast lever is more days per setup, not more same-day trades or cleverer statistics.
bullets: Observer: same-day trades are correlated (ICC ~0.19); doubling a setup's same-day trades adds almost nothing (4.8 -> 5.1 effective).
No verdict rule (raw, shrinkage, e-process) beats the 69% 'demote everything' base rate on 26 live sessions; a setup's own excess mean-reverts.
Where reps are lost (Scout, 37,202 live signals): the Setup Generator by account halts and buying power (~126 signals a session); low-rep setups by borrow (HTB names can't be shorted).
Calibrated replays: a mirror-live replay is built; it runs tonight under research rule 21's audit (95% match, within 0.03R, never optimistic).
Tonight: owner memo ranking levers by new setup-days, plus the REGSW results.
next: FWDCAL calibration and REGSW runs tonight; Scout's setup-days column; Observer's owner memo; evening PR.
